+package game
+
+import "testing"
+
+// TestFactoryNGPumpUntilEotAbilitySelfNoTarget covers the
+// pump_until_eot_ability_self_no_target primitive (ticket
+// engine.auto-pump-until-eot-ability-self-no-target-9e24f96767, Terra
+// Ravager class: "Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end
+// of turn, where X is the number of lands defending player controls."):
+// a triggered pump_until_eot atom with no explicit target must resolve
+// the buff against the ability's own source creature instead of no-oping.
+// Behavior test: a no-target pump_until_eot previously hit the
+// ExecuteAbilityEffect case's no-target guard and returned nil without
+// registering any effect; after the change the source creature's power
+// must carry the bonus for the rest of the turn.
+func TestFactoryNGPumpUntilEotAbilitySelfNoTarget(t *testing.T) {
+	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
+
+	source := NewCreature("Test Terra Ravager", ManaCost{}, 0, 4, 1)
+	source.Controller, source.Owner = 0, 0
+	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(source)
+
+	// No Targets at all — the atom names no target, only "it" (the
+	// source itself).
+	stackObj := &StackObject{
+		IsAbility:  true,
+		Text:       "pump_until_eot",
+		Controller: 0,
+		Card:       source,
+		EffectValue: map[string]interface{}{
+			"power":     3,
+			"toughness": 0,
+		},
+	}
+
+	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(stackObj); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	if got := source.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); got != 3 {
+		t.Fatalf("power = %d, want 3 (0 base + 3 from self no-target pump)", got)
+	}
+	if got := source.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); got != 4 {
+		t.Fatalf("toughness = %d, want 4 (unaffected — printed +3/+0)", got)
+	}
+}
+
+// TestFactoryNGPumpUntilEotAbilitySelfNoTarget_TargetedUnchanged is the
+// negative example: a pump_until_eot atom WITH an explicit target
+// creature must keep resolving exactly as before — the bonus lands on the
+// chosen target only, never on the ability's source.
+func TestFactoryNGPumpUntilEotAbilitySelfNoTarget_TargetedUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
+	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
+
+	source := NewCreature("Test Terra Ravager", ManaCost{}, 0, 4, 1)
+	source.Controller, source.Owner = 0, 0
+	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(source)
+
+	target := NewCreature("Test Target Bear", ManaCost{}, 2, 2, 1)
+	target.Controller, target.Owner = 0, 0
+	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(target)
+
+	stackObj := &StackObject{
+		IsAbility:  true,
+		Text:       "pump_until_eot",
+		Controller: 0,
+		Card:       source,
+		EffectValue: map[string]interface{}{
+			"power":     2,
+			"toughness": 2,
+		},
+		Targets: []Target{{Type: TargetCreature, CardID: target.ID, IsCard: true}},
+	}
+
+	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(stackObj); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	if got := target.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); got != 4 {
+		t.Fatalf("target power = %d, want 4 (2 base + 2 targeted pump)", got)
+	}
+	if got := target.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); got != 4 {
+		t.Fatalf("target toughness = %d, want 4 (2 base + 2 targeted pump)", got)
+	}
+	if got := source.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); got != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("source power = %d, want 0 (source must not be pumped by a targeted atom)", got)
+	}
+}
